headline: Integrative omics methods link pathway axes, PTM co-variation and spatial coupling
label: Multi Omics Data Integration
summary: Recent preprints extend omics integration from tensor decomposition and pathway scoring to tumor PTM co-variation and spatial neighbor coupling.
synthesis: The shared thread is recovering coordinated structure across molecular layers or spatial context, rather than analyzing each layer in isolation. The hippocampal and colonic study applies unsupervised HOSVD to mouse transcriptomic and methylation data to select aging-linked genes. PathwayTheme inverts the usual PCA workflow by scoring pathways per sample, decomposing those scores, and testing components against biological and technical covariates. PTMlink offers a queryable resource scoring glycosylation-phosphorylation co-variation at site level across 1,211 CPTAC tumor samples. Human kidney spatial transcriptomics is analyzed to infer subcellular process networks and test spatial neighbor coupling against null models. Two items explicitly test derived structure against confounders or null models, which is the most distinctive methodological element. The remaining items differ in organism, data type and deliverable, so this is a dominant rather than universal pattern.
